1	---
2	name: unity-localization
3	description: Configure Unity Localization with unity-cli. Use when the user asks to create Locale or String Table assets, bind Localize String Event to UI text, or verify localized text after switching locale in Play Mode. Do not use for package installation alone; use `unity-package-management`. For generic eval use `unity-editor-tools`; for UI interaction alone use `unity-ui-automation`; for capture alone use `unity-playmode-testing`; for generic assets use `unity-asset-management`.
4	allowed-tools: Bash(unity-cli:*), Read, Grep, Glob
5	metadata:
6	  author: akiojin
7	  version: 0.1.0
8	  category: ui
9	  triggers:
10	    - localization
11	    - locale
12	    - string table
13	  siblings:
14	    - unity-package-management
15	    - unity-editor-tools
16	    - unity-ui-automation
17	    - unity-playmode-testing
18	    - unity-asset-management
19	---
20	
21	# Localization
22	
23	Create persistent localization assets and prove that switching locale changes
24	the actual UI label, using existing unity-cli tools and public Unity APIs.
25	
26	## Use When
27	
28	- Create Localization Settings, Locale assets and String Table Collections.
29	- Bind a table entry to UI text through Localize String Event.
30	- Verify English/Japanese or another requested locale pair in Play Mode.
31	
32	## Do Not Use When
33	
34	- Only manage UPM dependencies: `unity-package-management`.
35	- Only evaluate generic C# or inspect console: `unity-editor-tools`.
36	- Only interact with existing controls: `unity-ui-automation`.
37	- Only capture media or control Play: `unity-playmode-testing`.
38	- Only edit ordinary assets: `unity-asset-management`.
39	- Only create a scene: `unity-scene-create`; only build Addressables content:
40	  `unity-addressables`. Translation authoring, external translation services and
41	  localized audio are outside this text-localization workflow.
42	
43	## Preferred Flow
44	
45	1. Follow [runtime prerequisites](references/runtime-checklist.md). Pin the
46	   project/endpoint; record Editor and package versions, active scene, existing
47	   settings, locales and target label. Stop Play before persistent edits.
48	2. Follow [construction and verification](references/localization-workflow.md).
49	   If needed, install an Editor-compatible `com.unity.localization` with
50	   `package_manager`; wait for reload and idle compilation, then inspect errors.
51	   Reuse the installed compatible version and existing Addressables settings.
52	3. With `editor eval` / `eval_csharp`, use public Localization Editor APIs to
53	   create or reuse settings and requested Locale assets. Register locales and
54	   create/reuse a String Table Collection. Add the requested key and translations
55	   to its per-locale tables. Save tables, shared data and settings with
56	   `AssetDatabase`; do not hand-edit serialized YAML or overwrite unrelated keys.
57	4. On the requested text object, configure `LocalizeStringEvent.StringReference`
58	   and a persistent `OnUpdateString` listener to the label's text setter. Use a
59	   font containing all requested glyphs. Preserve existing listeners and layout.
60	   Save the scene and assets, reload them, and inspect the binding and entries.
61	5. Enter Play and wait for `LocalizationSettings.InitializationOperation` to
62	   finish successfully. Set `SelectedLocale` to the first available locale.
63	   Poll the actual label with `get_ui_element_state` until it equals the expected
64	   translation; capture and inspect a Game screenshot. Repeat for the second
65	   locale with unchanged framing, and then switch back to verify reversibility.
66	   Never assign the label text directly to make this test pass.
67	6. Compare UI state and visible glyphs, not merely the locale code, table lookup,
68	   successful commands or different image hashes. Missing keys, fallback to the
69	   first language, blank labels or missing Japanese glyphs are failures. Inspect
70	   console errors and stop Play; restore any temporary editor-preview locale.
71	7. Report resolved versions, saved assets/scene, key and expected/actual strings,
72	   binding persistence, both screenshots and console results. Link separately
73	   tracked tool gaps; do not add CLI/bridge functionality inside this workflow.
74	
75	## Examples
76	
77	- "英語・日本語の Locale と String Table を作り、Play で表示を切り替えて確認して。"
78	- "Bind this label to the greeting entry and verify Japanese text is rendered."
79	- "Only install com.unity.localization" → `unity-package-management`.
80	
81	Use the same explicit project and endpoint on every call:
82	
83	```bash
84	unity-cli raw package_manager --json '{"action":"list"}'
85	unity-cli editor eval 'UnityEngine.Localization.Settings.LocalizationSettings.InitializationOperation.IsDone' --output json
86	unity-cli raw eval_csharp --json '{"code":"UnityEngine.Localization.Settings.LocalizationSettings.SelectedLocale = UnityEngine.Localization.Settings.LocalizationSettings.AvailableLocales.GetLocale(\"ja\");","mode":"statements"}'
87	unity-cli raw get_ui_element_state --json '{"elementPath":"/LocalizationCanvas/Greeting"}'
88	unity-cli raw capture_screenshot --json '{"captureMode":"game","width":1280,"height":720,"osFallback":false}'
89	unity-cli raw read_console --json '{"count":50,"logTypes":["Error","Exception"]}'
90	```
91	
92	## References
93	
94	- [runtime-checklist.md](references/runtime-checklist.md): connection and reload recovery.
95	- [localization-workflow.md](references/localization-workflow.md): assets, persistent events and checks.
96

1	# Localization construction and verification
2	
3	Use public APIs from the installed package, through `unity-cli editor eval`.
4	Keep calls synchronous and short; query async completion in subsequent calls.
5	Inspect `unity-cli tool schema eval_csharp` and `get_ui_element_state` before
6	constructing payloads. A transport success containing a tool error is failure.
7	
8	## Package and assets
9	
10	Inspect package metadata before choosing a version. The Unity 2022.3 manual lists
11	Localization 1.4.4; the registry can recommend a later compatible version.
12	Do not assume a Unity 6 package works on an older Editor.
13	Use `package_manager install`, then wait for ping, `isCompiling:false`,
14	`isUpdating:false`, resolved package version and console checks.
15	
16	Choose a scoped folder, such as `Assets/Localization/Demo`. In repository E2E,
17	use `Assets/Scenes/Generated/E2E/Localization` for generated scenes/assets.
18	Inspect existing settings before creating any asset. Use
19	`LocalizationEditorSettings.ActiveLocalizationSettings` to select an existing
20	settings asset, or persist a new `LocalizationSettings` asset and assign it.
21	Do not replace an existing project's startup selectors or Addressables groups.
22	
23	For each requested code, use `Locale.CreateLocale("en")` / `("ja")` only when
24	that locale is absent, save it with `AssetDatabase.CreateAsset`, then register
25	it with `LocalizationEditorSettings.AddLocale`. Verify both are available.
26	
27	Use `LocalizationEditorSettings.GetStringTableCollection(name)` to detect an
28	existing collection. Otherwise call `CreateStringTableCollection(name, folder,
29	locales)`. This handles shared data and Addressables registration; creating loose
30	`StringTable` objects does not establish the complete collection. Use
31	`collection.GetTable(locale.Identifier)`, add a missing locale table when needed,
32	and call `StringTable.AddEntry(key, translation)`. Mark changed tables and
33	`SharedData` dirty, then `AssetDatabase.SaveAssets`. Read back matching shared key
34	IDs and each exact translation. Example values: key `greeting`, English
35	`Hello, world!`, Japanese `こんにちは、世界！`.
36	
37	## Persistent UI binding
38	
39	Use the requested UGUI Text or TextMeshPro label. Assign its compatible font
40	asset with Japanese glyph coverage before judging the translation. A correct
41	`text` property with square replacement glyphs is not a successful visual check.
42	
43	Add/reuse `UnityEngine.Localization.Components.LocalizeStringEvent`. Configure
44	`StringReference.TableReference` and `TableEntryReference` with the persisted
45	collection and key. Wire its `OnUpdateString` to the text property setter using
46	`UnityEditor.Events.UnityEventTools.AddPersistentListener<string>` and a
47	`UnityEngine.Events.UnityAction<string>` targeting that setter. A temporary
48	`AddListener` lambda disappears on scene reload. Do not remove other listeners
49	or add a duplicate when retrying. Mark the component/scene dirty and save.
50	
51	Reload the scene in Edit Mode. Read the persistent event target/method, table
52	and key, and saved translations before entering Play. Do not replace a dirty
53	user scene without preserving its changes.
54	
55	## Runtime proof
56	
57	1. Enter Play. Wait for initialization completion and successful operation status;
58	   if it fails, inspect missing settings, locales and Addressables diagnostics.
59	   Do not block the main thread with a sleep or an async wait inside eval.
60	2. Set `LocalizationSettings.SelectedLocale` using
61	   `AvailableLocales.GetLocale("en")`; fail if it returns null.
62	3. Poll `get_ui_element_state` for the specific label until its actual `text`
63	   equals `Hello, world!`. Use a bounded deadline and allow frames between polls.
64	4. Capture Game view with `osFallback:false`; inspect the returned image.
65	5. Set the selected locale to `ja`, wait for `こんにちは、世界！`, and capture
66	   with identical camera/resolution. Inspect that the text is visible and legible.
67	6. Switch back to `en` and verify the original label text. Read console errors,
68	   stop Play and verify the saved assets and persistent event again.
69	
70	Do not use direct text assignment, editor preview alone or a String Database
71	lookup as proof of the live binding. On `GAME_VIEW_NOT_FOCUSED`, focus the Game
72	view through `unity-editor-tools` and retry. If the Editor cannot take foreground
73	focus, or a Game capture omits overlay UI, retain the failure (#422) and use the
74	actual Game-frame fallback. Through `editor eval`,
75	open the Game view with `EditorApplication.ExecuteMenuItem("Window/General/Game")`
76	and call `UnityEngine.ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot(absolutePngPath)` in Play.
77	Wait for a rendered frame and the file to finish writing before reading it.
78	Keep Game resolution fixed for both locales and inspect the resulting images;
79	this captures actual Game UI, not a constructed image or OS-window fallback.
80	Persist image paths, label state, versions,
81	saved Locale/table assets and the tool transcript as evidence.
82	
83	## API references and authorship
84	
85	This workflow is independently authored from the repository tool contract and
86	Unity's public package APIs, without official unity-agent-plugin skill content.
87	
88	- [Localization Editor APIs](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.localization@1.4/api/UnityEditor.Localization.LocalizationEditorSettings.html)
89	- [Localize String Event](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.localization@1.4/api/UnityEngine.Localization.Components.LocalizeStringEvent.html)
90	- [Unity 2022.3 package compatibility](https://docs.unity3d.com/2022.3/Documentation/Manual/com.unity.localization.html)
91
